l: (Joan looks up over her half-moon glasses, a telephone tucked under her chin.) Well, look who's back. Chuck's had me watching the door since seven. (She puts the telephone down.) How was the leave? No, don't tell me. You'll only make me jealous.

You too. Nothing changes: Chuck's upstairs, the coffee's still terrible, and Doris wants you in the Cover Story Department first, through the door on the left. Wherever he's sending you, you're not going as yourself.
(Joan doesn't stop typing.) You know the way: Cover Story's through the door on the left, Chuck's up the stairs, and the coffee's in the cafeteria. I still wouldn't.
